lines.text: Babylon is captured and Marduk is shattered, and a nation will make her land a desolation.
Israel and Judah will come weeping, ask the way to Zion, and join the LORD in an everlasting covenant.
The LORD says to flee Babylon because He is bringing great nations from the south against her.
Israel is a scattered flock; the king of Egypt devoured him first, and Nebuchadnezzar crushed his bones last.
